title: Whole-Book V2 Hierarchical Input Pipeline
user_summary: Replaces full-book synthesis with a hierarchical window → intermediate → consolidation → final synthesis pipeline so long novels stay within safe context and remain resumable.
technical_summary: Adds capacity-based WindowPlan/TokenPlan/CostPlan with CONTEXT_SAFE gate; persists window and topic intermediate assets; consolidates protagonist arc, hook lifecycle, chapter pacing, and assessment without sending raw full-book text to final synthesis; formal UI consumes progress stages and V2 contracts.
acceptance_criteria: hierarchical input pipeline implemented in product code
final synthesis receives no raw full book
verification_evidence: Frontend targeted Vitest: 2 files / 9 tests passed
1299 dry-run: windows=13 calls=31 max_tokens=109884 context=128000 margin=8000 CONTEXT_SAFE=YES

data_compatibility.notes: Uses existing WholeBookCheckpoint JSON for intermediates/progress; no formal user DB writes.

provider_impact.notes: Planning and deterministic extraction only; live provider acceptance deferred.
